name: La Cueva Raspberry Farm
tagline: Link to La Cueva Raspberry Farm Facebook Page at https://www.facebook.com/lacuevafarm/
description: La Cueva Raspberry Farm is a pumpkin patch in NM 442, NM. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, best in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
